items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: And one of my engineers through all of the albums with Dolly, Gary Paczosa, said one time

ctx.x: That’s great. She was so prolific, or she is so prolific, I wonder if you ever talked about where her song inspiration comes from.

Well I don’t want to speak for her but I’ve heard her say enough times she’s very spiritual. She gets up very early in the morning, 3, 4 or 5 — 3 or 4 in the morning, and would always walk out and had this thing, “Hello, God.” And Dolly has, all of her houses, in every room, her office, everywhere she has a place, whether it’s L.A., Nashville, East Tennessee, there’s a pad and a pencil and a pair of glasses, drug store glasses, in every room. You walk in there’s a pad, there’s a pencil, and the glasses. And in…
And some that you didn’t pick might end up on the next record?
